related.text_en: The winner of an Anthropic hackathon open sourced his entire Claude Code setup - and this is absolute f*cking gold 68 subagents, 286 skills, 94 commands, MIT license ECC turns Claude Code from one assistant into a full engineering team It plans before it builds, writes the failing test first, then reviews its own work from a fresh context. • the agents, by job > planning - one line in, a blueprint you approve before any code exists > review - reads your diff in a clean context. separate reviewers per language > build repair - one resolver per toolchain, down to PyTorch and CUDA > security - an OWASP pass, plus a scanner for injection risks in your agent config > architecture - design calls before they become migrations > domain work - database queries, ML pipelines, e2e tests, docs that security pair is what people skip an outside OWASP review runs four figures and takes a week this one runs on your branch before lunch • the skills, by category > testing - tdd-workflow gates red to green. eval-harness sits on top > language packs - Python, Go, Rust, C++, Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, Next.js > context - search-first reads the docs first. iterative-retrieval keeps your repo out of the window > shipping - Docker, CI/CD, health checks, rollbacks, migrations > not code - writing in your voice, market research, pitch decks strip it down and ship your own version tomorrow start with one plan and one rules pack installing all 286 skills at once is the fastest way to make it worse the devs who wire this up over a weekend spend next quarter reviewing output instead of typing it

related.text: 称 GPT-6 Astra 单任务约 21K token，Fable 5.1 约 64K：同价三倍产出，两小时活 Astra 二十分钟干完。
related.why: Astra vs Claude 效率对比，选型相关
related.text_en: OpenAI might actually kill Anthropic. GPT 6 Astra uses 21K tokens per task. Fable 5.1 uses 64K. Same price per token, three times the output for the same job. That is why a two hour Fable task takes Astra 20 minutes. And it is why your Claude Code limits die in 30 minutes. You are not using Claude too much. Fable 5.1 just burns three times the tokens to do the same thing. OpenAI built the model that does not need them. The end of Anthropic starts with a chart like this.

related.author: Elliot Arledge (@elliotarledge)
related.text: GPT-6 Astra 写出抢下 RTX PRO 6000 Mega 榜的 megakernel，Kimi-Linear Decode 达 PyTorch 基线 24.80×。
related.why: Astra 写内核刷榜，硬核性能
related.text_en: GPT-6 Astra wrote the megakernel that takes the RTX PRO 6000 Mega lead from Anthropic. It was tested on: Kimi-Linear Decode for RTX PRO 6000. 24.80x the optimized PyTorch baseline. > Claude Fable 5 at 24.61x, the July record > Claude Fable 5.1 at 22.95x > GLM-5.3 at 19.435x One cooperative launch, 376 blocks x 256 threads, 13 grid.sync() barriers. Scalar-FMA int4 GEMVs; tensor cores only for absorbed-MLA attention, with cp.async double buffering. KDA state updates, both RMSNorms and routed/shared MoE experts stay inside that launch. 23.66x / 24.95x / 25.85x at 2K / 8K / 16K context, 0.323 to 0.359 ms per token. Fable 5.1 used a hand-rolled task queue and tensor-core dequant GEMVs. Astra beats it with grid.sync() phases and scalar FMA on the bandwidth-bound batch-1 GEMVs. Cosine 1.0000 on all six check combos. It reverted two faster variants that fell to 0.983 to 0.9997. codex CLI 0.140.0 on OpenRouter, model openai/gpt-6-astra-pro, effort xhigh. 5h05m, 489,551 output tokens, $83.75. Ended on its own task_complete.
related.text_zh: GPT-6 Astra 写出抢下 RTX PRO 6000 Mega 榜的 megakernel，Kimi-Linear Decode 达 PyTorch 基线 24.80×。

related.why: Astra 空间工作流，AI 视频兴趣直击
related.text_en: One of the biggest problems with AI video has never really been making a beautiful frame. It’s keeping the space believable once the camera starts moving. That’s why the spatial side of GPT-6 Astra is interesting. Instead of leaving the entire shot to a prompt, the 3D environment can be mapped first, with camera and character paths kept within the Viewport. The scene can then be manually brought into CapCut PC and rendered with Seedance 2.5. After that, CapCut PC takes over again for the actual edit. If AI video is moving toward more controllable production, this kind of workflow feels worth exploring on the PC side. #CapCutPC #GPT6Astra #AIVideo #Seedance25
